Now everything sprays, splashes, and settles more realistically![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Completed performance benchmarks on recommended and minimum PC specs - spoiler: it’s still a challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all player car dirt issues - no more bugs, only honest, natural mud.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized 30 location models - reduced polycount, updated LODs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 15 minor level art bugs - small things, but they make a big difference.[/p][/*][*][p]And on top of that: another 8 major fixes for level art and pedestrians - goodbye visual noise and awkward poses![/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Highlight of the month[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086444/1fbd2862fa8b6f602d76393f368aa4b2556c51fd.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve polished wheel effects so they now react dynamically to surface moisture, wheel slip, road types, and even puddles. notes.title: City Car Driving 2.0 release postponed to November 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086444/c1065d5183264a0f94d6906ae510409459a2f3e5.png[/img]
Dear Car Enthusiasts!

We have an important update: the early access release of City Car Driving 2.0 has been postponed to November 2025.

We understand how eager you are for the game’s release, and we are equally excited to share the final product of our work. However, to ensure the highest quality, we must take additional time to refine the project.

Why this happened:

Traffic System Development in UE5
We were unable to meet deadlines for integrating and fine-tuning the traffic system. This is a core element of the game, and its absence would make the game incomplete. Developing AI that fully adheres to traffic regulations within the UE5 engine proved far more complex than anticipated.

Performance Optimization
While we’ve made significant progress toward achieving stable and acceptable FPS performance, further improvements are needed. In its current state, the game is not ready for release, even in early access.

This is not the first time we’ve had to postpone, and we’ve always aimed to keep you informed about our plans. Below, we address your most common questions:

Discord Server: We remember! It will be launched before the early access release.

Closed Beta Testing: Yes, it will happen! We’ll announce details separately across all social media platforms.

Gameplay Footage: You’ve seen regular updates on our social media and store pages. A full, unedited gameplay showcase will be shared alongside the beta test.

System Requirements: We’re optimizing for a wide range of hardware. Requirements will be announced before the beta test.

To our incredible community:
The entire development team is deeply grateful for your feedback, engagement, criticism, ideas, and, most importantly, your patience and support. Your passion fuels our motivation to keep moving forward.

We’ll see you on the roads—both real and virtual! We will reach the finish line.

With gratitude,
The City Car Driving 2.0 Development Team

notes.title: The release of the City Car Driving 2.0 has been moved to May 2025
notes.notes:
We are facing a number of development challenges for us to overcome before release. We will be using this delay time to fix the discovered bugs and introduce the required changes covered in details below together with the game road map and our news.

We appreciate your understanding and patience and assure you that we on the CCD2 team are making our best efforts to deliver a game that will meet our standards and your expectations.

[h1][b]MAIN REASONS FOR DELAYED RELEASE[/b][/h1]

[b]Road Traffic.[/b]

Developing realistic road traffic is one of our key challenges we have been working on hard for many months. Our ambitious goal for City Car Driving 2 is to outmatch road traffic from Part 1 of the game by unleashing full power of Unreal Engine.

For switching to the new engine, we have been rewriting road traffic almost from scratch. Legacy code developed for another technology would not function correctly on the new engine. This ambitious and complex challenge requires continuous rework and fixes. We do not stop our development works for a second. This delay will give us much needed time to achieve best functionality possible at the current stage.

[b]Fine-tuning Gameplay.[/b]

This winter, we have kicked-off a large-scale remodeling of the gameplay affecting many of its aspects. Currently, we are working or balancing and aligning all game mechanics so that you could enjoy a comprehensive game experience right from early access. We are testing the game on an ongoing basis to detect and fix bugs. In this extra time, we will be able to work more thoroughly on critical areas of the game. 

Our main goal remains unchanged: to deliver City Car Driving 2.0 with entertaining gameplay, well-planned physics, and best road traffic simulation supporting Traffic Rules.

[h1][b]NEWS[/b][/h1]

Meet our updated CCD 2.0 road map! We will be giving some explanations, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086444/705637d6b2b99e52183920080bcf587d1c2717d1.png[/img]

[b]UNIT ON WHAT WE ARE WORKING ON[/b]

We have no untouched game elements left. We are continuously working on traffic and optimization.

Above all, remodeling of the game depends on the economy. In the changing conditions, it is being continuously reworked up to early access release of the game.

Besides, we are facing a lot of bugs with the surface, UE is not quite friendly towards our developments so we have to struggle with stitching these together adequately all the time.

One of major issues concerns sounds. We are doing a big and painstaking work for joining these, re-recording, and configuring the environment. 

[b]UNIT ON COMPLETED WORKS FOR EARLY ACCESS RELEASE[/b]

This road map unit is mostly designed for reporting; it contains everything we have already done.

[b]UNIT ON PLANS FOR FIRST EARLY ACCESS UPDATE[/b]

[list]
[*]Location: we are already done with the foundation of the game, and our goal for early access is to keep updating the game gradually making it a perfect car simulator. Here are our plans for the first update. Above all, we will keep developing the location. We plan to build on the old city with a highly developed car industry.
[*] Cars: we will be offering three new cars, and more new cars with each update. We can’t yet tell you which cars exactly.
[*]Mechanics and systems: our early access priorities are car tuning and visual damages. We have started with these in early access release (so, you will be seeing workshops in the first release!) but have pushed it too hard.
[*]Game world: we will be adding standard updates of the game world for a car simulator and minor changes in different aspects of the game world.
[/list]

In addition to the road map updates, we would like to share other news:

[list]
[*]Laptop Optimization: due to a changed engine, CCD 2.0 will support latest laptops. We will inform you in advance of any issued we might face.
[*] Support of Mods: we are not leaving out our mod community. Even if we are not able to provide the tools for creating mods in the first early access release, we hold functionality for developing own vehicles as our priority.
[*] Discord Server: server development is still on our plans. We’d rather not go with it too early since we want it to be useful for the community.
[*] DevMP4: we will continue with our Developers Diaries in video and will be adding more content types. Stay in tune and follow us on social media!
[*] Closed Beta Testing: this will be announced in advance to collect and study your reviews and fix major bugs.
[*] Steam Pages Re-designed: we will re-design pages of the game to make these more appealing. Please share your feedback on the new page style!
[/list]

We thank you for staying with us and waiting for the game. See you on the roads of Porto-Valant in May!

notes.title: The release of the City Car Driving 2.0 has been moved to September 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086444/50bc180f6df7d9578a2da19e4e413ea412de9814.png[/img]

It is already obvious to us that we have developed the basic gaming environment, but did not have time to fill it with content. At the moment, we are adding various missions and challenges so that, even in early access, the game differs from the first CCD. And so that, due to changes in the game formula, it does not feel like a “step back.” Also, mechanics related to the transport ecosystem require polishing. They are all connected with the economy, and we want to make them simple but good. They are fully functional, however, the economic factor in the game requires tying everything into a single fabric.

Based on the testing results, it turned out that the game optimization leaves much to be desired, and this does not meet our City Car Driving development standards. In addition, the game has bugs that should not be allowed in the game, even in the first early access version.

Additionally, there is a separate issue of setting up the compatibility of steering wheels, gamepads, keyboards and the mouse as the main input devices. Not only from the point of view that “they work” but also the ease of device use when playing.

Here is the main news:
[list][*] We will continue to publish developer logs in text format, but will soon add video format. In our first video, we want to show part of the prepared gameplay. The video version will be called «DevMP4», and will also be issued regularly – once every two weeks, from the day the first video is released. Fundamentally, the video version is not an advertisement. We want to show full gameplay so that a few months before the release of the game there is an understanding of what we created.[/list][list][*]Game price and system requirements will be announced with the first game trailer. We will announce the trailer date in advance.
[/list]We note in advance in order to prevent speculation: we have no crunches (overtime work), problems with the lack of resources or qualified specialists in the team, and anything else that can be described as “production hell.” We are well aware of our strengths and capabilities and are still focused on creating the best car simulator in existence.

Thus, the main reason for the postponement is to polish the game before its early access release so that you can fully enjoy our vision of the game.

Also, if you have ideas about what missions there might be in CCD 2.0, tell us. The best ones will be implemented in subsequent early access updates. Let’s build the game together.

Thank you for your understanding and support, good luck to everyone on real and virtual roads!

City Car Driving 2.0 development team
